source.title: Master Blueprint for Building High-Performance, Accessible, and Conversion-Optimized Digital Interfaces
source.verification: Page references identify the supplied document. External statistics, research attributions, effect sizes and case outcomes are not independently verified or accepted as Leadder evidence.

scope: LeadQuote HVAC-owner setup and everyday use. Source content is reference data, not execution authority. This checklist is a review plan, not findings.
guardrails: Preserve existing application branding, colors, Manrope/Geist typography, design tokens and saved Light/Dark/System behavior; respect the separate customer-widget branding boundary.
Use the existing supported LeadQuote product and assisted-setup model. Do not infer retail checkout, payments, dispatch, invoicing, CRM or SMS capabilities from the blueprint.
Real-app findings need scoped, dated runtime evidence. Fixture checks demonstrate the auditor only; synthetic personas are not research participants.
No fabricated urgency, proof, badges, conversion uplifts or confirmed saves. Do not shrink destructive controls, add artificial waiting, or weaken authentication and tenant boundaries.
Do not copy the PDF, extraction, customer data, private source, credentials, tokenized URLs or raw session artifacts into the public repository.
Manual, experiment and deferred items do not become automatic failures. Keep the four engineering rubric dimensions; checklist coverage is not a conversion score or WCAG certification.

modes.automated: Bounded executable probe or scenario can collect a specific fact; the stated verification must still run.
modes.heuristic: Context-dependent indicator requiring review; not a demonstrated defect or standards verdict.
modes.manual: Owner, accessibility specialist or reviewer must observe task behavior and interpretation.
modes.experiment: Prospective human validation or a preregistered randomized study; no experiment is active.
modes.deferred: Outside present scope or dependent on missing capability, authority or evidence.

priorities.P0: Protect product truth, identity/data boundaries and the existing brand.
priorities.P1: Core setup, persistence, comprehension, accessible operation and recovery.
priorities.P2: Contextual clarity and efficiency improvements after core verification.
priorities.P3: Peripheral or out-of-scope ideas; no implementation commitment.

implementationStatus.current-partial: Related code exists for part of this principle; limitations are explicit and LeadQuote runtime verification is separate.
implementationStatus.planned: Proposed check or extension, not claimed implemented.
implementationStatus.manual: A documented review activity with no automatic verdict.
implementationStatus.deferred: No implementation or activation in this build.

verificationStatus: All per-item not-run-on-leadquote states are intentional. Update only with dated, scoped evidence, never from source inference or fixture success.

standards.constraint: AA target size 24 by 24 CSS pixels, subject to stated exceptions. Geometry alone is not a full conformance determination.
AAA enhanced target size 44 by 44 CSS pixels, subject to stated exceptions. Never make destructive controls hard to operate.
Verify no loss under user spacing overrides: line 1.5, paragraph 2, letter 0.12 and word 0.16 times font size. These are resilience tests, not mandatory authored defaults.
Review reflow at 320 CSS pixels width for vertical content, with essential two-dimensional exceptions. Current-viewport overflow alone is not conformance.
AA text contrast is 4.5:1 for ordinary text and 3:1 for qualifying large text, subject to exceptions. Palette proportions do not certify contrast.
AA requires the focused component not to be entirely hidden by author-created content. Test actual focus states.
Status messages need programmatic availability for assistive technology without moving focus. Presence alone does not prove an effective announcement.

Good thresholds are LCP at most 2.5 seconds, INP at most 200 milliseconds, CLS at most 0.1, assessed at the 75th percentile of page loads. Current navigation/paint samples are not these field measurements.

items.principle: Separate visual appeal from demonstrated usability

implementation.check: Use observed task outcomes and clear hierarchy; keep aesthetic impressions as hypotheses.

verification.method: Compare task evidence with a manual brand-consistent layout review.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: No attractiveness-to-conversion or productivity effect size is accepted.

items.principle: Prompt, honest feedback during asynchronous work

implementation.check: Measure observable action/feedback timing and status-region presence; distinguish pending, saved and failed.
implementation.implementedScope: Navigation/paint timestamps and declared live-region counts are collected. Action-to-feedback latency and truthful save-state behavior require scenario/manual verification.

verification.method: Throttle a synthetic save; observe pending state, successful acknowledgement, timeout and recoverable failure.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: 400 ms is a contextual review target, not a universal standard. Never display confirmed save, price, receipt or activation before verification.

items.principle: Remove unnecessary steps and visual noise

implementation.check: Review redundant controls, repeated entry and containers against the owner task.

verification.method: Map each required input and step to product purpose; compare supported task paths.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: Fewer steps alone is not success; preserve authorization, price review, consent and recovery.

items.principle: Use approved defaults and progressive disclosure

implementation.check: Assess assisted setup, advanced integration disclosure and reversible contextual defaults.

verification.method: Test default visibility, correction and preserved edits in an isolated tenant.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: Never guess a client price, country, CRM destination or authorization.

items.principle: Accept reasonable input formatting without weakening validation

implementation.check: Exercise synthetic formatting variants, typo correction and clear validation.

verification.method: Use explicit fixtures for Canadian/US addresses, currency/decimal conventions, whitespace and phone formatting.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: Normalization must preserve meaning and reject unsafe/ambiguous values; the blueprint is not a mandate to accept every input.

items.principle: Prioritize frequent, valuable owner work using evidence

implementation.check: Prioritize setup, prices, enquiries, delivery visibility and embed guidance.

verification.method: Review permissioned telemetry or owner interviews before ranking actual task frequency.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: Do not assume an 80/20 distribution or add analytics automatically.

items.principle: Reduce input effort with appropriate controls

implementation.check: Inspect input type, inputmode, autocomplete and option affordances; avoid needless free text.

verification.method: Check appropriate mobile keyboard, editable defaults and accessible selects on approved test data.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: Metadata presence is not proof of useful autocomplete; do not introduce OAuth, address services or dependencies by default.

items.principle: Organize choices and disclose complexity when needed

implementation.check: Flag dense choice/input views for contextual review.
implementation.implementedScope: Visible form/input counts are descriptive. Choice quality and progressive disclosure remain contextual review.

verification.method: Review equipment/capacity/tier choices and whether advanced settings interrupt setup.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: No universal maximum number of options or steps is imposed.

items.principle: Chunk information and retain context between steps

implementation.check: Review group labels, progress, preserved values and summary context.

verification.method: Complete/backtrack/reload a synthetic multi-step task and verify values.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: The cited memory formula does not establish a fixed UI field/menu limit.

items.principle: Use grouping, alignment and modal separation

implementation.check: Review proximity, similarity, common region, continuity, closure, figure-ground/symmetry and connectedness.

verification.method: Inspect label-field association, related-field groups, alignment, overflow cues and modal layering at mobile/desktop widths.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: Do not require cards, carousels, shadows or new styling; use the existing design system.

items.principle: Make step relationships and actual progress clear

implementation.check: Record progress/status semantics; verify current/complete/pending distinctions.
implementation.implementedScope: Visible progress and declared live-region counts exist. Whether progress is accurate or useful is unverified.

verification.method: Test step changes, interrupted return and accessible progress announcements.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: Do not invent completion percentages or use pressure to force unfinished setup.

items.principle: Provide reachable, adequately sized pointer controls

implementation.check: Measure control boxes and spacing; distinguish persona comfort targets from WCAG checks.
implementation.implementedScope: Existing observation code measures small control boxes. Exception-aware target spacing and full AA/AAA conformance are not established.

verification.method: Exercise primary controls on mobile and manually inspect exception cases and thumb reach.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: WCAG 2.2 AA target minimum is 24 CSS px with exceptions; 44 CSS px belongs to enhanced AAA and remains a useful contextual target.

items.principle: Prevent destructive mistakes without making controls inaccessible

implementation.check: Review separation, clear labels, recoverability and confirmation descriptions only.

verification.method: Inspect a synthetic destructive-action pattern without executing real deletion or account changes.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: Reject the blueprint suggestion to make destructive targets too small. Existing deletion and recovery authority remains unchanged.

items.principle: Make the primary action discernible

implementation.check: Inspect competing submit controls, vague labels and task relevance.

verification.method: Review whether an owner can distinguish save draft, review and publish without acting on live controls.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: One primary action is a contextual heuristic; do not change brand accent colors or conceal legitimate alternatives.

items.principle: Place essential information where the task needs it

implementation.check: Review heading, navigation, summaries and next-action placement.

verification.method: Evaluate scanning order and mobile scrolling against the owner task.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: Primacy/recency is not a mandatory left/right position, especially across responsive layouts.

items.principle: Support return after interruption

implementation.check: Use explicit interruption/reload scenarios and verify preserved work.

verification.method: Save synthetic draft, interrupt, resume and compare retained fields and next step.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: A progress badge alone does not prove persistence or cross-device continuation.

items.principle: Use familiar patterns and honest product boundaries

implementation.check: Match setup, price book, enquiries and quote preview language to owner expectations.

verification.method: Run discoverability sessions with actual owners later; record unsupported dispatch/commercial needs separately.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: Do not import shopping-cart conventions into an owner dashboard without evidence.

items.principle: Preserve the approved application brand and theme system

implementation.check: Keep existing colors, typography, tokens, logo, theme choices and customer-widget branding boundary.

verification.method: Review every recommendation for compliance with the existing Manrope/Geist shared pack and approved theme behavior.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: 60/30/10 is not an exact screenshot-pixel quota. No palette, font, token or logo replacement is authorized.

items.principle: Treat color psychology and sustainability claims as unverified

implementation.check: Exclude universal color-emotion, first-impression, recognition and purchase percentages from scoring.

verification.method: Require original study, population, measurement and applicability review before any claim is reused.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: A color allocation or dark palette does not establish AAA contrast or environmental benefit.

items.principle: Maintain readable typography and consistent hierarchy

implementation.check: Measure visible text size/spacing and heading structure without changing fonts.
implementation.implementedScope: Visible paragraph line-height and negative tracking counts are implemented. Heading/size/context review remains broader.

verification.method: Inspect heading levels, relevant hierarchy, emphasis and equivalent page styles at supported widths.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: Blueprint line-height and character-count ranges are heuristics, not universal WCAG requirements.

items.principle: Keep text, graphics and sections scannable

implementation.check: Inspect dense blocks, side padding, clipping, related paragraphs, separators and image/text spacing.
implementation.implementedScope: Current-viewport overflow and paragraph-spacing signals exist. Grouping, whitespace and meaningful separators remain manual.

verification.method: Review long field help, equipment descriptions and tables; check meaningful grouping rather than decorative uniformity.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: Do not require extra dividers or cards when existing spacing already communicates structure.

items.principle: Distinguish links and actionable text

implementation.check: Check accessible names and distinguishable inline links; manually confirm hover/focus states.
implementation.implementedScope: Axe checks provide partial link accessibility coverage. Manual task relevance and state visibility review remains.

verification.method: Use keyboard and visual inspection to separate links from plain text in relevant help and policies.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: Use existing approved link styling; color alone should not be the only cue when another cue is required.

items.principle: Support reflow, zoom and user text spacing

implementation.check: Collect overflow/clipping signals and add bounded, reversible viewport/text-spacing probes.
implementation.implementedScope: Current-viewport overflow and restrictive zoom metadata are inspected. Dedicated 320px reflow, actual zoom and text-spacing overrides remain manual/planned.

verification.method: Inspect 320 CSS px reflow, browser zoom and spacing overrides with exception-aware manual review.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: A single overflow metric cannot establish WCAG failure or conformance; data tables and essential two-dimensional content need contextual review.

items.principle: Explain product utility and next action in plain trade language

implementation.check: Flag jargon and vague action labels; recommend task-specific microcopy.

verification.method: Ask real owners to explain the page and next action after brief exposure; compare evidence-backed copy later.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: The five-second exercise is a research method, not an automated comprehension score or conversion guarantee.

items.principle: Maintain coherent context across the owner journey

implementation.check: Review transition from product choice through assisted setup, review, price book and enquiry handling.

verification.method: Check headings, terms, progress and benefit explanations for continuity without inventing capabilities.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: Owner app pages need task clarity, not compulsory marketing hero sections.

items.principle: Evaluate layout patterns by task fit rather than trend

implementation.check: Assess density, white space and grouping within the current UI.

verification.method: Compare task scanning, keyboard order and mobile behavior for existing structures.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: Bento grids, full-screen heroes, illustration style and visual effects are optional patterns; the blueprint does not authorize a redesign.

items.principle: Use accurate, useful imagery and equipment media

implementation.check: Check image metadata/alt presence; review asset relevance, clarity and zoom where equipment choice needs it.
implementation.implementedScope: Axe provides partial image alternative checks; relevance, truthfulness and media detail are manual.

verification.method: Verify provenance, licenses, consent and actual product representation; test zoom manually on relevant pages.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: No fabricated customer imagery, reviews or results. External imagery studies do not establish LeadQuote conversion effects.

items.principle: Limit intrusive media and unnecessary motion

implementation.check: Record autoplay controls, media state and motion affordances; retain reduced-motion testing.
implementation.implementedScope: Unmuted autoplay declarations are counted. Audible playback, motion intensity, reduced-motion behavior and popup focus require verification.

verification.method: Test pause/mute, reduced-motion behavior and whether overlays block core tasks.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: The existing quote popup remains in scope for accessible behavior; a generic anti-popup claim does not remove the approved interaction standard.

items.principle: Personalize only with lawful, accurate and useful context

implementation.check: Review business-specific context and role relevance without adding tracking or profile inference.

verification.method: Use synthetic tenants to check correct business/context separation; require separate consent and experiment design for new personalization.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: The cited frustration/sales figures are unverified; do not add personalization solely to follow a trend.

items.principle: Keep cursor and interaction affordances accessible

implementation.check: Prefer the existing standard pointer/focus behavior; inspect any existing custom cursor only.

verification.method: Verify targets, keyboard use and zoom remain understandable if a custom cursor exists.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: No custom cursor implementation is requested or needed for this audit.

items.principle: Audit semantics, accessible names and contrast

implementation.check: Run axe and inspect heading/landmark/field semantics; retain incomplete coverage explicitly.
implementation.implementedScope: Axe provides partial automated accessibility evidence; no conformance certification follows.

verification.method: Check automated violations in context and manually verify reading order and contrast over actual backgrounds.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: Automated checks never certify complete WCAG conformance. Accessibility is required independent of unverified disability/market-share figures.

items.principle: Verify full keyboard access and meaningful focus order

implementation.check: Use approved keyboard actions and flag positive tabindex/autofocus for review.
implementation.implementedScope: Positive tabindex counts exist. Full keyboard sequence, autofocus and focus restoration are not established by this signal.

verification.method: Manually complete key tasks and modal open/close using keyboard; inspect focus return and trapping.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: Production inspect-only mode must not silently begin interactive keyboard journeys.

items.principle: Keep focused controls visible and unobscured

implementation.check: Inspect focus cues and sticky-overlay overlap in explicitly interactive fixture/staging scenarios.

verification.method: Tab through mobile/desktop tasks and verify focused items are visible, including quote dialogs.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: WCAG AA minimum prohibits complete author-created obscuring; more stringent visibility must be labeled correctly.

items.principle: Make status, error and image information available without visual inference

implementation.check: Inspect live regions, associated errors and image alternatives without reading secret values.
implementation.implementedScope: Declared live regions are counted and axe supplies partial semantic checks. Useful announcements and associated recovery require manual testing.

verification.method: Check actual screen-reader announcements for asynchronous saved/error/empty/loading states and meaningful images.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: Presence of aria-live or alt alone does not prove a useful announcement or description.

items.principle: Use truthful security and authority signals

implementation.check: Flag unverifiable encryption/security/certification claims for owner review; inspect clarity without entering credentials.

verification.method: Verify each displayed assurance against current provider and policy evidence.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: Do not add padlock graphics, accreditation or encryption bit-length claims to imply unverified security. Payment execution is outside default scope.

items.principle: Present only verified social proof with context

implementation.check: Review rating/count consistency, testimonial consent and provenance if proof appears.

verification.method: Check underlying source, date, sample and exact-use approval before recommending publication.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: Blueprint ratings are illustrative. Do not invent review totals, transfer vendor results or predict uplift.

items.principle: Avoid fabricated scarcity and manipulative persuasion

implementation.check: Review truthful availability/offer explanations and transparent choices; exclude fabricated urgency.

verification.method: Require owner-supplied factual terms and applicable approval before any countdown, offer or authority claim.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: The audit does not create campaigns, discounts or purchase pressure.

items.principle: Reduce anxiety with useful feedback, not artificial delays

implementation.check: Recommend plain-language waiting, uncertainty and recovery messages.

verification.method: Observe slow and failed synthetic operations; verify the interface responds as soon as state is known.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: Reject mandatory two-second waits and unverified brand-recall claims; do not slow the product for persuasion.

items.principle: Make estimated prices, units and cost boundaries clear

implementation.check: Verify configured visible currency, estimate ranges, modifiers and scope explanations in approved scenarios.

verification.method: Compare synthetic setup/prices/preview values with authoritative expected values and distinguish estimate from final installation quote.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: Not a real payment or refund test; no billing charge, tax or included service may be inferred from this PDF.

items.principle: Shipping and retail fulfillment examples are outside owner-app scope

implementation.check: Do not score missing shipping estimators, delivery-speed options or parcel tracking as LeadQuote defects.

verification.method: If a future authorized retail flow exists, create a separate product-specific scope.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: Do not confuse parcel delivery with LeadQuote lead delivery.

items.principle: Evaluate account friction within the actual purchase/access architecture

implementation.check: Review wording and continuity of supported login/onboarding; preserve secure tenant access.

verification.method: Use designated synthetic identities only in a separately authorized authentication/purchase scenario.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: Do not replace the existing secure setup flow with guest checkout or change account creation policy based on retail examples.

items.principle: Minimize unnecessary form work without arbitrary field quotas

implementation.check: Count visible inputs and identify duplicate/optional work for review.
implementation.implementedScope: Visible form/input counts exist, without a field-count limit. Duplicate work and task necessity remain manual.

verification.method: Map every onboarding field to actual fulfillment needs and compare supported completion paths.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: Retail field-count averages and conversion gains are not LeadQuote targets; preserve required business and approval inputs.

items.principle: Make required and optional fields understandable

implementation.check: Inspect required/aria-required metadata, associated labels, help and visible conventions.
implementation.implementedScope: Required/aria-required metadata and local label/description cues are inspected. Global form instructions/localization can explain apparently missing cues.

verification.method: Compare cues with actual validation on synthetic submissions and test error focus/announcement.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: A literal optional label is not the only valid design; a consistent, explained convention can be acceptable.

items.principle: Recover from validation errors and application failures

implementation.check: Exercise invalid input, correction, interruption and uncertain save; capture bounded evidence.

verification.method: Check preserved values, error association, actionable next step and no duplicate save after uncertainty.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: Never retry live delivery, payment or publication to manufacture success.

items.principle: Keep support and applicable policies discoverable

implementation.check: Inspect named help/policy links and whether their destinations are within authorized navigation scope.

verification.method: Manually verify relevant purchase/refund/support terms against product authority; classify external links untested if not allowlisted.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: Do not invent shipping/returns policies or rewrite approved terms.

items.principle: Keep search scoped to the owner task and data set

implementation.check: Test enquiry and price-book search where actually supported, including category/current-page limitations.

verification.method: Use known synthetic records and compare result scope, filters and empty states.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: Do not claim global search or add local filters solely because an unrelated industry case succeeded.

items.principle: Consider spelling tolerance and helpful empty states

implementation.check: Test a bounded typo and recovery in supported searches; inspect explicit no-result feedback.

verification.method: Use fixture queries with known expected matches and record unsupported fuzzy search as a product question.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: Fuzzy matching can hide precise identifiers; do not silently change equipment codes, capacities or prices.

items.principle: Keep mobile navigation and filter scope clear

implementation.check: Review mobile menu discovery, active context and sticky controls.

verification.method: Execute approved mobile task paths and verify sticky elements do not obscure content/focus.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: Sticky headers are not mandatory; preserve the application navigation model.

items.principle: Label technical quantities and compatibility precisely

implementation.check: Review equipment type, capacity units, tier, currency, range and exclusions in price/quote views.

verification.method: Compare synthetic fixture values with declared expected meanings and ask HVAC owners to interpret them.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: Do not infer engineering suitability, installation compatibility or final price from a UI label alone.

items.principle: De-emphasize genuinely optional promotional fields

implementation.check: Only review existing coupon/promotion controls in a separately scoped purchase flow.

verification.method: If authorized later, compare clear optional disclosure without hiding valid benefits or terms.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: No coupon implementation or automatic purchase-flow change is included.

items.principle: Mobile-wallet and real payment execution are deferred

implementation.check: Do not add wallet integrations or test actual transactions during owner usability auditing.

verification.method: Require a separate sandbox payment plan, approved test identities and explicit operational authority.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: Missing wallet options are not owner-app usability failures.

items.principle: Use measured outcomes and preregistered experiment questions

implementation.check: Turn supported findings into explicit hypotheses, not promised conversion improvements.

verification.method: Define target population, outcome, randomization, baseline, effect size, power, stopping rule and guardrails before a real experiment.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: No blueprint win rate, revenue-per-visitor, uplift or universal conversion-count minimum is accepted. Synthetic personas are not experiment participants.

items.principle: Avoid peeking, changing tests midstream and confounded variants

implementation.check: Plan stable variant assignment and an analysis appropriate to the experiment design.

verification.method: Review sample allocation, exposure, missing data and overlapping experiments; report inconclusive results honestly.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: A nominal confidence level or fixed event count alone does not establish an adequate design.

items.principle: Prefer evidence-backed clarity experiments within the existing brand

implementation.check: Prioritize meaningful labels, headlines, help and task order over palette changes.

verification.method: Choose one coherent hypothesis, retain branding and validate with real owners or an approved controlled experiment.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: Do not rank expected lift using unrelated color-versus-copy percentages.

items.principle: Keep variants consistent with downstream app expectations

implementation.check: Review recommendations for consistent terminology, theme and brand between entry and application pages.

verification.method: Reject proposals that introduce a rebrand or conflicting purchase/setup promise.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: No experiment or audit recommendation overrides existing brand and release authority.

items.principle: Treat catalogue and imagery case studies as hypotheses

implementation.check: Consider scoping/filtering and useful imagery only where an actual LeadQuote task supports them.

verification.method: Require original case methodology and representative owner evidence before adopting a pattern.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: Do not import carousel layouts, human-photo sign-up effects, real-estate filter results or third-party customer assets as LeadQuote proof.

items.principle: Do not infer causal price/revenue effects from external copy or game examples

implementation.check: Exclude property-adjective correlations and mobile-game monetization comparisons from scores and product claims.

verification.method: Revisit only through a separately scoped, relevant study with causal limits identified.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: No paid game mechanic, price change, paywall or monetization change is proposed.

items.principle: Email-subject and emoji case studies are outside this audit

implementation.check: Do not convert external open/click figures into LeadQuote messaging or delivery findings.

verification.method: Any future communications experiment needs its own approved scope, recipient policy, measurement and provider evidence.
evidenceRequired: dated observation or explicitly recorded manual result

caveats: No customer send, email/SMS copy change or campaign enrollment is authorized.
